requirements.text: Strong software engineering 3+ years experience with Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and REST APIs, including hands-on experience designing scalable and distributed enterprise backend applications.
Hands-on experience developing production GenAI/LLM applications, including LLM integration, prompt engineering, response evaluation, and enterprise AI use cases.
Strong production experience with RAG architectures, including embeddings, document ingestion, chunking, semantic retrieval, reranking, context construction, and RAG quality optimization.
Strong working knowledge of Python and FastAPI, with experience building AI/ML services and integrating Python-based AI components with Java/Spring Boot applications.
Hands-on experience with Vector Databases and GenAI frameworks, such as Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, FAISS, ChromaDB, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or Hugging Face.
Experience with cloud and modern deployment practices, including AWS, Azure, or GCP, Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, observability, and production deployment of AI services.
Additional exposure to Agentic AI, MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI guardrails, LLMOps, Kubernetes, knowledge graphs, multimodal AI, and event-driven microservices is advantageous.
